accent.role: Swiss red — the ONLY accent: markers, key figures, active states

good.role: positive status is set in ink with a red square marker — never a second hue

ink.role: the one ink — type, rules, frames

paper-2.role: turned page — table heads, index bands

geometry.grid: 12 columns desktop / 8 tablet / 4 mobile, 24px gutters; a visible grid overlay ships in the Style Guide
geometry.shadow: none — depth is drawn with rules and paper tones, never blur

name: Raster
reference: Swiss International Typographic Style — Josef Müller-Brockmann grid systems. One reference, held everywhere.
rules: One reference: the Swiss grid poster. If it could not be printed in black and one red on white stock, it does not belong.
Radius 0 everywhere. No gradients. No soft shadows. No glassmorphism. No rounded cards.
The grid is visible: hairline rules structure every screen; content snaps to columns.
Everything is numbered: sections (01 — Overview), rows, invoices, figures.
Red is rationed: markers, one key figure per view, active states. Never decoration.
Dark theme is the same poster printed on black paper — never a different design.
Tables and rules instead of cards wherever the data allows.

display.use: oversized headlines and hero numerals — weight 800/900, tight tracking (-0.02em), left-aligned, ragged right
